_purpose: Exp38b: Item Gate + Cross interaction. User noise compressed, item S-tier features get independent token groups.
_format: Top-level keys: 'user_ns_groups' and 'item_ns_groups', each mapping a group name to a list of feature ids (fids).
_usage: train.py loads this file (path given by --ns_groups_json) and converts fids into positional indices.
_note_audit: Based on feature_audit: S-tier AUC>0.53, A-tier 0.51-0.53, B-tier <=0.51. Item S-tier features get independent groups for Item Gate module.
_note_T: T = num_queries*num_sequences + num_ns = 1*4 + (3+4+6) = 17. d_model=64, 64%17≠0 → RankMixer ffn_only.
_note_user_dense: All user dense features (fid 61/62/63/64/65/66/87/89/90/91, total_dim=918) → 4 NS tokens via dense_token_groups=4. Not configured here.
_note_shared_fids: Fids 62/63/64/65/66/89/90/91 appear in both user_int_feats and user_dense_feats. Their int parts are kept in U_dense_int group for dense-aligned routing.
